paper: ATLAS: Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS Through Dynamic Prompt Optimization and Multi-Agent Coordination
headline_strategy: ATLAS combines daily market, news, and fundamental analyst summaries with portfolio/execution state in a Central Trading Agent, then uses Adaptive-OPRO every five trading days to rewrite the agent's static instruction prompt from realized ROI feedback while preserving the order-level interface.
headline_selection_basis: The abstract, Sections 3-5, and v5 headline tables identify Adaptive-OPRO applied to the Central Trading Agent—not StockSim alone or a technical baseline—as the proposed strategy.

paper_configuration.action_space: order-level type, side, size, timing and price

missing_atlas_objects: the fixed baseline Central Trading Agent instruction and exact filled runtime prompts
the Adaptive-OPRO optimizer implementation, meta-prompt, model requests/responses and edit history
the complete optimization history of prompts, five-day outcome summaries and scores
the paper's promised o4-mini Adaptive-OPRO sample configuration
the exact three-asset experiment matrix, seeds and three-run artifacts
frozen Massive/Polygon market data plus aligned news and fundamental inputs
the paper's CTA actions, orders, fills, cash, positions and portfolio trajectories
provider snapshot/decoding parameters for all seven backbones
paper result arrays and report-generation lineage
